"""More entry-count edge cases: huge products, clip boundaries, 1514 splits."""
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/site')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import reference
from online_matching.match_p4 import exact_entry_count

rng = random.Random(777)
fails = 0

# 1514-saturated patterns
cases = [
    ([[[1514, 1514], [0, 5]]], 10),                       # empty product
    ([[[1510, 1520], [1510, 1520]]], 100),                # splits at 1514
    ([[[0, 3028]]*3], 5),                                 # huge product clip
    ([[[1513, 1515], [1513, 1515]]], 100),                # 2x2 = 4 keys
    ([[[1513, 1515], [1513, 1515]], [[1513, 1515], [1513, 1515]]], 100),  # dedupe
    ([[[1513, 1515], [1513, 1515]], [[1514, 1515], [1513, 1514]]], 100),  # same sets
    ([[[100, 101], [200, 201]], [[101, 102], [201, 202]]], 100),          # overlap
]
for pats, cap in cases:
    mine = exact_entry_count(pats, cap)
    kept = [{'range': p} for p in pats]
    ref = reference.entry_count(kept, 'exact', cap)
    status = 'ok' if mine == ref else 'FAIL'
    if mine != ref:
        fails += 1
    print(status, 'cap=%d' % cap, 'mine=%s ref=%s' % (mine, ref), pats if mine != ref else '')

# clip boundary: exact union == cap, cap+1, cap+2
for extra in range(0, 3):
    # pattern with exactly cap+extra keys
    cap = 10
    n = cap + extra
    # n keys as [0,n-1] x [0,0]
    pats = [[[0, n-1], [0, 0]]]
    mine = exact_entry_count(pats, cap)
    kept = [{'range': p} for p in pats]
    ref = reference.entry_count(kept, 'exact', cap)
    if mine != ref:
        fails += 1
        print('CLIP FAIL', extra, mine, ref)

# many boxes wide ranges (shortcut path)
t0 = time.time()
pats = []
for i in range(200):
    pats.append([[0, 3028], [i, min(3028, i+50)], [1000, 1010]])
mine = exact_entry_count(pats, 8192)
kept = [{'range': p} for p in pats]
ref = reference.entry_count(kept, 'exact', 8192)
print('wide:', mine, ref, '%.2fs' % (time.time()-t0))
if mine != ref: fails += 1

# many boxes, huge volumes, small cap
t0 = time.time()
pats = [[[0, 3028], [0, 3028]] for _ in range(300)]
mine = exact_entry_count(pats, 3)
kept = [{'range': p} for p in pats]
ref = reference.entry_count(kept, 'exact', 3)
print('huge:', mine, ref, '%.2fs' % (time.time()-t0))
if mine != ref: fails += 1

# worst-case enumeration volume: many boxes of size just below kcap
t0 = time.time()
rng2 = random.Random(5)
pats = []
for i in range(400):
    w = rng2.randint(0, 90)
    pats.append([[i, i+w], [0, 89]])
mine = exact_entry_count(pats, 8192)
kept = [{'range': p} for p in pats]
ref = reference.entry_count(kept, 'exact', 8192)
print('enum:', mine, ref, '%.2fs' % (time.time()-t0))
if mine != ref: fails += 1

print('fails =', fails)
EOF
